title: Grateful Dead Live at Cal Expo Amphitheatre on 1993-05-25
lineage: DAT Clone > TASCAM DA-20 > M-Audio Audiophile 192 > Soundforge 8.0 wav > Steinberg WaveLab 4.01a (dithered after downsampling with Waves L3 Ultramaximizer) > CDWave > Trader's Little Helper
source: FOB Schoeps Mk2 Omni Capsule 7' spaced omnis in hat -> Schoeps Active Cables -> Schoeps CMC 5 Mic Body -> Monster M1000 Jumper -> Neumann Supply -> Canare Cable -> Panasonic sv255

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard recording captures a well‑played, high‑energy show with good vibes throughout.
ai_review.review: The reviewers note that the soundboard (SBD) feed is crisp, though they prefer the audience mix for its extra bass. The band was in good spirits, weather perfect and energy high, delivering solid performances of every song without any glaring flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed review gives a clear positive impression of both performance and recording quality, but limited data lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Soundboard is described as crisp; reviewer prefers audience mix for more bass, indicating overall clarity but a slight tonal preference.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Straightforward set with every song well played; high energy and good vibe throughout the night.
